page.notes: Blank page. It carries only manuscript ink, which is handwriting and not printed text, so it is left out: a dedication inscription at the top ("Ex dono Ill^mi et Rev^mi Domini Cardinalis Francisci Barberini", with "Non. Ste. Lonivy? Roncali"), a shelf mark ("XVI B 27"), and a faded reddish mark ("a.c.c.", probably a stamp or annotation). Show-through and stains are present, and there is no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
